Auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to get to your pastes.
Auth.signInLegal: By continuing you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.
Auth.signUpLegal: By creating an account you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.
Auth.signInPitchBody: Paste code, choose when it expires, and share the link. Every paste shows how often it was opened.
Auth.expiresInDays: Expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
Auth.signUpClosedSubtitle: Sign-up is closed on this instance. Ask the administrator if you need an account.
Auth.closedPitchBody: New accounts can't be created here right now. If you already have an account, sign in.
Auth.inviteOnlySubtitle: Sniptide is invite-only while it's in early access. Apply and we'll send you an invite.
Auth.invitePitchBody: Sniptide is still changing fast, so we're letting people in a few at a time. Apply and we'll add your email.
Auth.signUpSubtitle: Free for up to {limit, number} MB of pastes.
Auth.signUpSubtitleNoLimit: Free to use on this server.
Auth.signUpPitchBody: Public pastes are listed on your profile. Private and unlisted pastes are only visible through their link.

errors.credentials: That email and password don't match an account.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
errors.signIn: Couldn't sign you in. Try again.
errors.signUp: Couldn't create your account. Check your details and try again.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Try another one.
errors.usernameInvalid: Usernames are 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores.
errors.provider: Couldn't reach the sign-in provider. Try again.
errors.resetRequest: Couldn't send the reset link. Try again.
errors.reset: Couldn't save your password. Try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

Auth.forgotPasswordSubtitle: Enter the email you sign in with and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
Auth.resetUnavailableSubtitle: Password reset by email isn't set up on this instance.
Auth.resetUnavailable: Ask the administrator of this instance to reset your password.
Auth.resetUnavailableSocial: Sign in with GitHub or Google if you connected one, or ask the administrator of this instance to reset your password.
Auth.resetLinkSent: If an account uses {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.
Auth.chooseNewPasswordSubtitle: Saving it signs you out on every device.
Auth.resetLinkExpired: This reset link has expired or was already used.
Auth.passwordResetDone: Your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.

oauthErrors.accountNotLinked: An account already uses this email. Sign in with your password, then connect the provider in Settings.
oauthErrors.inviteOnly: Sniptide is invite-only for now. Apply for access to get in.
oauthErrors.signUpClosed: Sign-up is closed on this instance, and no account is connected to that login.
oauthErrors.emailNotFound: The provider didn't share an email address. Add a verified email there and try again.
oauthErrors.alreadyLinked: That login is already connected to another Sniptide account.
